newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains feedlots to raise offers to $68 - trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains feedlots to raise offers to $68 - trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle will be priced at $68.00 per cwt next week, up $2.00 from $66.00 trades this week, feedlot managers said.

Price optimism was fueled by smaller showlists expected next week, a large percentage of short-fed cattle on those lists, ideas packers will need cattle early next week and by cold and snow forecast for Texas and Oklahoma early next week.

The Texas Panhandle area was forecast to turn cold Sunday with snow due on Monday, sources said. Most cattle being sold now are lightweight and a severe storm, that could slow weight gains, could aggravate the situation.
"We are going to price them at $68 but realistically we will probably get to $67," said a Texas manager.
The bulk of this week's sales occured at $66.00.
Feedlots are very current with most of the cattle sold this week originally scheduled for late December and early January showlists.
